newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Vitoria airport cargo fell 17 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Vitoria airport cargo fell 17 pct in Jan.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Vitoria airport in northern Spain fell to 1,722 tonnes in January, from 2,083 tonnes in the same month 1996, a decrease of 17 percent, the airport authority said.
This reverses the steady increases of 1996 in which total cargo rose to 26,721 tonnes against 13,782 tonnes in 1995.

Vitoria started commercial cargo operations in 1994 and showed monthly growth rates of as much as 150 percent last year. It has become an important centre for frozen fish and express package freight. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
